bullets.text: Apple Music Import Tool Launched - **Apple** makes switching from other platforms easier with its new import tool.
Samsung Android 16 Update Confirmed - **Samsung** announces rollout of Android 16 for various Galaxy devices starting October.
iOS 26 Now Available - **Apple** releases iOS 26, featuring a new Liquid Glass design and enhanced functionalities.
AirPods Pro 3 Review - **Apple**'s latest AirPods Pro 3 enhance comfort and fit, solidifying their market position.
iPhone Air's Portrait Mode - **Apple** introduces advanced Portrait Mode on the new iPhone Air, expanding photography capabilities.
Amazon's Prime Day Announced - **Amazon** sets October 7-8 for its fall Prime Big Deal Days, promising great deals.
Nothing's $200M Series C - **Nothing** secures $200 million in funding to launch AI-first devices, boosting its valuation.
Microsoft Office Adds Copilot - **Microsoft** integrates free Copilot Chat features into Office apps for enhanced productivity.
PayPal Introduces Payment Links - **PayPal** launches new payment links feature, soon to support cryptocurrency transactions.
Snap OS 2.0 Unveiled - **Snap** launches Snap OS 2.0 with a native browser and WebXR support for its AR glasses.
